test_title: PYST 57: SSC CPO - General Knowledge and General Awareness (Held on 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following is NOT the manifestation of Iron-deficiency anaemia (IDA)?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Blindness**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Iron deficiency anemia (IDA)** manifests in various ways, but one of the** not** commonly associated manifestations is **blindness.**
 
• Other conditions (such as** vitamin A deficiency** or specific **eye diseases**) can cause blindness, but they are not directly related to IDA.
 
• **Symptoms of IDA:**
 
 
• **Extreme Fatigue:** Individuals with IDA often experience severe tiredness and weakness.
 
• **Pale Skin:** The skin may appear unusually pale due to reduced hemoglobin levels.
 
• **Cold Hands and Feet:** Poor circulation can lead to cold extremities.
 
• **Brittle Nails:** IDA affects nail health, causing them to become brittle.
 
• **Inflammation or Soreness of the Tongue:** Known as glossitis, this condition can occur.
 
• **Unusual Cravings for Non-Nutritive Substances:** Some people with IDA crave ice, dirt, or starch (a condition **called pica**).
 
• **Poor Appetite in Infants and Children: **Children with IDA may have reduced appetite.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**** Soft Palate:**

 
• The** soft palate** is the fleshy part at the back of the roof of the mouth.
 
• In IDA, the soft palate may appear pale due to reduced hemoglobin levels.
 
• This paleness is a result of decreased oxygen-carrying capacity in the blood.

**General Pallor:**

 
• **General pallor** refers to the overall paleness of the skin.
 
• It is a common sign of IDA due to reduced red blood cell production.
 
• The skin, mucous membranes, and conjunctiva (lining of the eyes) may all appear pale.

**Paleness of Conjunctiva of Eyes:**

 
• **The conjunctiva** is the thin, transparent layer covering the white part of the eye.
 
• In IDA, the conjunctiva may appear pale (a condition called conjunctival pallor).
 
• **Anemia **affects the blood vessels in the conjunctiva, leading to paleness.
